entries.dialogueText: "Nothing will ever happen to me. I'm basically immortal."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It will never end badly between us.""
entries.dialogueText: "It will never end badly between us."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Then we'll continue in secret. As..."
